entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:1
segments: ¶I am a narcissus of Sharon, A lily of the valleys.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:2
segments: As the lily among thorns, So is my love among the daughters.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:3
segments: ¶As the apple-tree among the trees of the wood, So is my beloved among the sons: In his shadow have I rapture and sit down; And his fruit is sweet to my taste.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:4
segments: He hath brought me to the house of wine, And his banner over me is love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:5
segments: Sustain ye me with raisin-cakes, Refresh me with apples; For I am sick of love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:6
segments: His left hand is under my head, And his right hand doth embrace me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:7
segments: I charge you, daughters of Jerusalem, By the gazelles, or by the hinds of the field, That ye stir not up, nor awake [my] love, till he please.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:8
segments: ¶The voice of my beloved! Behold, he cometh Leaping upon the mountains, Skipping upon the hills.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:9
segments: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young hart. Behold, he standeth behind our wall, He looketh in through the windows, Glancing through the lattice.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:10
segments: My beloved spake and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:11
segments: For behold, the winter is past, The rain is over, it is gone:

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:12
segments: The flowers appear on the earth; The time of singing is come, And the voice of the turtle-dove is heard in our land;

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:13
segments: The fig-tree melloweth her winter figs, And the vines in bloom give forth [their] fragrance. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away!

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:14
segments: ¶My dove, in the clefts of the rock, In the covert of the precipice, Let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; For sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:15
segments: Take us the foxes, The little foxes, that spoil the vineyards; For our vineyards are in bloom.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:16
segments: My beloved is mine, and I am his; He feedeth [his flock] among the lilies,

entries.title: Song of Solomon 2:17
segments: Until the day dawn, and the shadows flee away. Turn, my beloved: be thou like a gazelle or a young hart, Upon the mountains of Bether.
